name: feature-crew
description: Turns one Claude Code session into an orchestrator: features and revisions you ask for are built by background feature-builder subagents, each on its own git branch in an isolated worktree, while the main conversation stays free. The orchestrator routes each feature to a Sonnet, Opus or Fable worker by a fixed procedure, climbs at most once to Fable when checks still fail, and a model-check hook confirms each worker ran on the model chosen for it and records its token use. The main session keeps a roster, relays workers' questions to you, resumes them with your answers, and reports when each one is done.
